**Expression:** `fact_al8860_sense_max / fact_rlp25_resistance_min`

**Depends on:**

- [`fact-al8860-sense-max`](#fact-al8860-sense-max)
- [`fact-rlp25-resistance-min`](/docs/components/records/rlp25feer200/#fact-rlp25-resistance-min) on RLP25FEER200

**Fact:** [`fact-al8860-peak-current`](#fact-al8860-peak-current)

**Expression:** `fact_al8860_current_max * (1 + fact_al8860_ripple_fraction / 2)`

- [`fact-al8860-current-max`](#fact-al8860-current-max)
- [`fact-al8860-ripple-fraction`](#fact-al8860-ripple-fraction)
